summary: Son of Bull Smith — John's 9th-great-grand-uncle; ancestor of the Woodhull, Gardiner/Tyler, Bailey and J. Lawrence Smith cousins.
bio: His eldest son inherited his mother Sarah Hammond's blunderbuss 'Old Crib'. Grandchildren include Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull (via Sarah) and Mary Smith Gardiner (via Nathaniel).
